rationale: Computed short-circuit currents: max 3-phase fault at near bus (0.2km) = 9.304 kA, min 2-phase fault at remote end (8km) = 1.508 kA. Breaker selected as smallest standard rating (12.5 kA) above 9.304*1.1=10.23 kA. Relay pickup 600 A is between load margin minimum (360*1.25=450 A) and fault sensitivity maximum (1508/2=754 A).
